summary: Electrical and Computer Engineering researcher and educator with a PhD from the University of Oklahoma and a research focus on artificial intelligence and machine learning for wireless networks. Research spans reliable and data-efficient learning, 5G/6G network intelligence, propagation modeling and digital twins, network optimization and self-healing, transfer learning, domain adaptation, generative modeling, reinforcement learning, and wearable intelligence. Experience combines university research and teaching with industrial R&D at AT&T Labs, Futurewei, and AT&T, with emphasis on rigorous experimentation, reproducibility, student mentoring, and translation of AI methods into real communication systems.
